extraction_notes: This document is a geotechnical cross-section (profile A-A', SW-NE orientation) showing three dynamic penetration tests P-1, P-2, P-3, NOT individual borehole logs with explicit depth-interval tables. Therefore: (1) SPT depth intervals per blow count are NOT available — only Nb values plotted graphically against elevation; (2) Layer boundary depths are estimated by reading elevations from the graphic scale and subtracting from surface elevation; (3) No USCS classifications, moisture, or consistency data are provided in this type of document; (4) Two geological levels are clearly defined in the legend (N1 and N2) and visible on the section; (5) Nb=R denotes refusal (equivalent to rock or very hard material). All depth_from_m / depth_to_m values for layers are approximate estimates from the graphic. A recommended foundation level (cota de fonamentació recomanada) is shown as a red dashed line on the section.
